language.name: English
settings.title: Settings
settings.clock.desc: Show the clock in the top right corner.
settings.fullScreen.desc: Use the whole screen instead of a window. The F11 key also toggles it.
settings.vsync.desc: Synchronize with the screen refresh to avoid tearing. The 5 key also toggles it.
settings.fps.desc: Show the frames per second in the bottom right corner.
settings.sound.desc: Enable or disable the sound of all the emulators.
settings.fmSound.desc: Emulates the YM2413 FM chip of the Japanese Master System. Games that support it play their FM music. Takes effect when the game is started again.
settings.channel1.desc: First square wave channel of the PSG. In game it is toggled with the 1 key.
settings.channel2.desc: Second square wave channel of the PSG. In game it is toggled with the 2 key.
settings.channel3.desc: Third square wave channel of the PSG. In game it is toggled with the 3 key.
settings.channel4.desc: Noise channel of the PSG (drums and effects). In game it is toggled with the 4 key.
settings.about.emulators.desc: Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000, ZX Spectrum and Chip-8.
